description: This file defines a class SecurityNotAllowedFunctionError within the Twig Sandbox namespace, representing an exception thrown when a disallowed function is used in a Twig template. It extends the SecurityError base class and includes methods for storing and retrieving the name of the disallowed function.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedFunctionError
classes.description: An exception class thrown when an unauthorized function is invoked within Twig's sandbox environment. It extends SecurityError and adds a property for the disallowed function's name.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new SecurityNotAllowedFunctionError with a message and the name of the disallowed function.

methods.name: getFunctionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the function that was not allowed.
